title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Acowebs Woocommerce…
description: A Path Traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) exists in Acowebs Woocommerce Custom Product Addons Pro up to version 5.9.0. This flaw allows an attacker to improperly limit pathname access, potentially leading to denial of service. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
